gloss: to converge; to subside; to come under control

definitions.gloss: to converge; to subside; to come under control
definitions.explanation: describes a situation, crisis, or phenomenon gradually calming down and reaching a stable resolution
a series, sequence, or value approaching a definite limit

notes:
Gained widespread everyday usage during pandemic reporting. In general use, describes a crisis or disturbance gradually coming to an end. In mathematics and science, has the precise meaning of approaching a limit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{収束|しゅうそく}する: the situation subsides
- ⟦{収束|しゅうそく}→収束：09135_shuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to head toward resolution
- ⟦{収束|しゅうそく}→収束：09135_shuusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧: outlook for resolution
- ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧⟦{収束|しゅうそく}→収束：09135_shuusoku⟧: early resolution

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{終息|しゅうそく}→終息：16713_shuusoku⟧: complete end/cessation — same pronunciation but written differently; implies total termination rather than gradual subsiding
- ⟦{沈静化|ちんせいか}→沈静化：19510_chinseika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to calm down — focuses on quieting rather than reaching a conclusion
- ⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧: to resolve — implies finding a solution, while ⟦{収束|しゅうそく}→収束：09135_shuusoku⟧ describes the natural winding down of a situation

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
⟦{収束|しゅうそく}→収束：09135_shuusoku⟧ (convergence, subsiding) vs. ⟦{終息|しゅうそく}→終息：16713_shuusoku⟧ (complete end). Both are used for crises, but ⟦{収束|しゅうそく}→収束：09135_shuusoku⟧ implies things are coming under control, while ⟦{終息|しゅうそく}→終息：16713_shuusoku⟧ means completely over.
